screen.rationale: Primary study; PS nanospheres with BiOI/CuWO4 films under a 300 W Xe lamp with AM 1.5G filter (passes E3), but polymer outcomes are only SEM average particle size (425 -> 350 -> 325 nm), FTIR band attenuation and solution TOC (1868 -> 1322 mg/L); no molar mass and no identified product quantified.

excluded_observations.what: Average PS particle size vs time
excluded_observations.why: Particle size is not an E5 endpoint.
TOC/mineralization is not an E5 endpoint.
Small-molecule dye, not a polymer substrate.
excluded_observations.loc: 2. Materials and Methods > 2.4. Photocatalytic Activity Evaluation ¶1
